seo.title: Territory maps, autocomplete, and geolocation · Chase Teichmann
seo.description: At Actifai I helped build territory management for the door-to-door sales app, so each team gets its own area, and I work on the location and address features around it.

sections.label: Territories
sections.html:
Actifai’s door-to-door sales app puts addresses on a map for reps to work, but managers had no way to hand an area to a team.

With teammates, I built both sides of it: the drawing tools managers use to outline clusters of addresses, assigning each territory to reps by user group, and the view where reps see their own territory. Now each team gets its own area.

sections.label: Location tracking
sections.html: Rep positions jumped around on the map, and the app’s location permissions weren’t handled correctly. I fixed both. The app now asks for location at the right moment and handles a rep who says no.

sections.label: Address autocomplete
sections.html: Every service order in Actifai’s online shop needs an address. Google Places autocomplete gets customers to a valid service address with less typing, so fewer orders come in with bad addresses.
